name: Cabo Frio

queries.query: Cabo Frio Brazil official cadastral parcel map geoportal cadastro imobiliário mapa lots municipal registry GIS
queries.result: Official results identified the Prefeitura de Cabo Frio, the municipal Fazenda/IPTU service, the municipal e-GOV service portal, and IBGE urban-sector maps. The municipal pages evidence an IPTU/cadastro imobiliário custodian and procedures, but no openly documented citywide parcel vector service was found.

queries.result: Resultados oficiais in Portuguese identified the Secretaria Municipal de Fazenda IPTU page, the municipal e-GOV portal, and municipal legislative material describing cadastro imobiliário and cadastro territorial multifinalitário. The public pages did not expose an anonymous parcel geometry endpoint or downloadable parcel dataset.

registryEvidence.custodian: Prefeitura Municipal de Cabo Frio, Secretaria Municipal de Fazenda (municipal IPTU/cadastro imobiliário); municipal planning/territorial cadastre functions are also evidenced in official municipal material
